comment: Reviewed voice lines for Iron Dust Rally. Text lives HERE, never in game code, so every spoken line is reviewable in one place before it is ever synthesised - the same rule the reindustrialize pipeline follows. Nothing here is wired into the build: the game is silent today and stays silent until playback is deliberately added.

announcer.comment: Stock ElevenLabs voice (Brian). Broadcast register - stage intros, results, menus. Deliberately NOT the cloned Zach voice: that clone is restricted to mentor dialogue by docs/ZACH_VOICE_CONSENT.md in the reindustrialize repo, and an announcer is not mentor dialogue.

codriver.comment: Stock ElevenLabs voice (Adam). In-car register - clipped, urgent, read at pace. Pace notes are called ahead of the corner, so these are short by design.

clips.text: Stage one. Clear road ahead. Driver, when you are ready.
